title: CLAUDE.md
text: cosmicsig primarily data package ships mutational-signature profiles COSMIC. R code thin: package help page, roxygen stubs document exported dataset, handful small helpers (get_etiology, possible_artifacts, rare_signatures, SBS96_ID_to_SBS192_ID). maintenance work regenerating .rda files data/ new COSMIC release comes , editing R source.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: Two “rolling-latest” package variables plus one frozen snapshot per release: signature — nested list [[genome]][[mutation_type]] genome ∈ {GRCh37, GRCh38, mm9, mm10, rn6} mutation_type ∈ {SBS96, DBS78, ID}. leaf matrix (rows = mutation classes, cols = signatures). ID defined GRCh37 indel classes don’t depend genome composition. etiology — parallel nested list character vectors describing signature’s known hypothesized cause. COSMIC_v3.0, COSMIC_v3.1, …, COSMIC_v3.5 — frozen per-release snapshots, list $signature + $etiology structure . signature etiology always mirror newest release. new COSMIC version lands, new COSMIC_v<X>.rda top-level signature.rda/etiology.rda need regenerated. Etiology deprecated. etiology data get_etiology() helper longer updated — versioned COSMIC may incomplete newer signatures. Leave place backwards compatibility, don’t invest effort extending ; direct users https://cancer.sanger.ac.uk/signatures/ instead.

title: CLAUDE.md
text: data-raw/COSMIC_v<X>/code/ directory self-contained build pipeline one release. v3.5 scripts : download_COSMIC_v3.5_sigs_from_website.R — pulls raw TSVs COSMIC generate_COSMIC_v3.5_genome_sigs.R — builds per-genome catalog matrices generate_COSMIC_v3.5_etiologies.R — builds etiology list generate_COSMIC_v3.5_data.R — entry point; sources two calls usethis::use_data(COSMIC_v3.5, overwrite = TRUE) check_version_difference.R — diffs previous release Run entry-point script package root (scripts use relative paths like data-raw/COSMIC_v3.5/...): cut new release, copy v<prev> directory, update URLs/paths, regenerate .rdas, also regenerate top-level signature.rda / etiology.rda point new release, add R/COSMIC_v<X>.R roxygen stub, update DESCRIPTION + NEWS.md.

text: inst/scripts/plot_all_human_signatures.R renders every human SBS96, DBS78, ID signature given COSMIC version (default v3.5, GRCh37) single combined PDF /tmp opens xdg-open. uses mSigPlot::plot_guess_pdf() qpdf::pdf_combine(). manual smoke test, testthat test, exercised devtools::test() CRAN checks. text: data package 2 main package variables: signature etiology. signature variable contains latest mutational signature profiles released https://cancer.sanger.ac.uk/signatures/ 3 mutation types: SBS (single base substitutions context preceding following bases, called SBS96 package) DBS (doublet base substitutions, called DBS78 package) ID (small insertions deletions) package variable etiology contains information known hypothesized causes mutational signatures. general, better use get_etiology. Deprecation note: etiology information longer updated may incomplete recent COSMIC releases. Consult https://cancer.sanger.ac.uk/signatures/ current etiologies. Earlier releases available variables COSMIC_version, e.g. COSMIC_v3.4. profiles SBSs signatures depend frequencies trinucleotides genome profiles DBS signatures depend frequencies dinucleotides genome. Therefore COSMIC package provide slightly different signatures different reference genomes. COSMIC package offer versions SBS DBS signatures human GRCh37 (also known hg19) GRCh38, mouse rat. ID signatures take consideration differing nucleotide composition reference genomes relating ID mutational categories extremely complicated. signatures due experimental laboratory artifacts. Function possible_artifacts returns .
